title: A Disorder-Aware Computational Framework to Identify Structurally Tractable Targets in Proliferative Vitreoretinopathy.
authors: Djulbegovic, Mak B; Hadzijahic, Nedym; Taylor Gonzalez, David J; Antonietti, Michael; Zafar, Sidra; Kuriyan, Ajay E
one_liner_zh: 该文提出一个无序感知的AI计算框架，整合IDR谱、氧化还原DOT分析和PPI网络，用RFdiffusion/AlphaFold为PVR中EMT调节因子SNAIL1设计从头结合物，虽对象非相分离且偏靶向发现，但无序介导互作机制建模思路对本课题有直接启发。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Proliferative vitreoretinopathy (PVR) remains a major cause of failure after rhegmatogenous retinal detachment repair and lacks effective pharmacologic therapies. Although epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is central to PVR pathogenesis, the structural determinants governing the tractability of EMT regulators, particularly those involving intrinsic disorder, remain poorly defined. We developed a disorder-aware, artificial intelligence-enabled computational framework to evaluate EMT-associated proteins in PVR and prioritize structurally tractable regulators for structure-based targeting. DESIGN: A computational, hypothesis-generating study employing an in silico screening and structural modeling pipeline. SUBJECTS: No human subjects or biological specimens were included. The dataset comprised 25 EMT-associated proteins implicated in PVR, curated through a narrative review of peer-reviewed literature. METHODS: Candidate proteins were evaluated using a multistage pipeline integrating intrinsic disorder profiling (Rapid Intrinsic Disorder Analysis Online), redox-sensitive disorder-to-order transition (DOT) analysis (AIUPred), and protein-protein interaction network assessment (Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins [STRING]). Structure-based modeling and generative binder design were then applied to the top-ranked candidate using RFdiffusion for de novo backbone generation, protein message passing neural network for sequence design, and AlphaFold2 for structural validation. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Primary measures were the proportion of intrinsically disordered residues, redox-sensitive disorder change, STRING network coherence within EMT-related pathways, and the structural consistency of the designed binder-target complex, assessed by root mean square deviation (RMSD) and mean per-residue confidence (predicted local distance difference test [pLDDT]). RESULTS: Of the 25 EMT-associated proteins screened, several exhibited intermediate intrinsic disorder profiles and measurable DOT potential. Snail Family Transcriptional Repressor 1 (SNAIL1) emerged as the highest-priority candidate, demonstrating an intermediate intrinsic disorder profile ( approximately 35%), a pronounced redox-sensitive DOT region, and selective connectivity within EMT-related signaling networks. Functional mapping of the SNAIL1 C-terminal DOT segment identified 6 basic residues with literature-supported or motif-based regulatory significance (K187, R191, R224, K234, K253, and R264). Following sequence design and structural validation, the top-ranked binder exhibited the lowest structural deviation within the generated ensemble (RMSD 18.5 A) and high per-residue confidence (mean pLDDT 0.84). CONCLUSIONS: Our study introduces a disorder-informed computational framework for prioritizing structurally tractable EMT regulators in PVR. As a proof-of-concept, the pipeline nominates SNAIL1 and generates a structure-aware de novo binder targeting its C-terminal DOT region, providing a foundation for disorder-based therapeutic discovery in fibrotic retinal disease. abstract_zh: 目的：增殖性玻璃体视网膜病变（PVR）仍是孔源性视网膜脱离修复术后失败的主要原因，且缺乏有效的药物治疗。尽管上皮-间质转化（EMT）是PVR发病机制的核心，但决定EMT调节因子可靶向性的结构决定因素，尤其是涉及内在无序性的那些，仍知之甚少。我们开发了一种无序性感知、人工智能驱动的计算框架，用于评估PVR中的EMT相关蛋白，并优先筛选结构上可靶向的调节因子，以进行基于结构的靶向干预。设计：一项计算性、假设生成性研究，采用计算机模拟筛选和结构建模流程。受试者：未纳入人类受试者或生物标本。数据集包含25种与PVR相关的EMT相关蛋白，通过叙述性综述同行评审文献进行整理。方法：候选蛋白采用多阶段流程进行评估，整合内在无序性分析（Rapid Intrinsic Disorder Analysis Online）、氧化还原敏感的无序-有序转变（DOT）分析（AIUPred）以及蛋白-蛋白相互作用网络评估（Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins [STRING]）。随后，对排名最高的候选蛋白应用基于结构的建模和生成性结合物设计，使用RFdiffusion进行从头骨架生成、蛋白消息传递神经网络进行序列设计，以及AlphaFold2进行结构验证。主要结局指标：主要指标包括内在无序残基比例、氧化还原敏感的无序性变化、STRING网络在EMT相关通路中的连贯性，以及设计的结合物-靶标复合物的结构一致性，通过均方根偏差（RMSD）和平均每残基置信度（预测局部距离差异测试 [pLDDT]）评估。结果：在筛选的25种EMT相关蛋白中，若干蛋白表现出中等程度的内在无序性特征和可测量的DOT潜力。Snail家族转录抑制因子1（SNAIL1）成为最高优先级候选，显示出中等程度的内在无序性特征（约35%）、显著的氧化还原敏感DOT区域，以及EMT相关信号网络中的选择性连接。SNAIL1 C端DOT片段的功能映射识别出6个具有文献支持或基序基础调控意义的碱性残基（K187、R191、R224、K234、K253和R264）。在序列设计和结构验证后，排名最高的结合物在生成的集合中表现出最低的结构偏差（RMSD 18.5 Å）和高每残基置信度（平均pLDDT 0.84）。结论：我们的研究引入了一种无序性信息化的计算框架，用于优先筛选PVR中结构上可靶向的EMT调节因子。作为概念验证，该流程提名SNAIL1并生成针对其C端DOT区域的结构感知从头结合物，为纤维化视网膜疾病中基于无序性的治疗发现提供了基础。财务披露：专有或商业披露可在本文末尾的脚注和披露部分找到。
